scope: Workspace reuse and non-destructive idle retention in the working tree.

findings.detail: A stable authenticated task without a trace session, or with a changed transport session, could create another checkout.
Different authenticated principal/story pairs intentionally have separate lists. Empty discovery does not establish that files were removed.
The previous age-only sweep could remove edits or locally committed work; reads did not refresh the retention timestamp.

changes: Reuse repo/ref/remote within the authenticated task; no pull or reset on reuse.
Converge concurrent default opens; fresh=true creates a separate checkout.
Track last use for workspace access and protect active test executions.
Idle removal requires a clean checkout at its recorded base with no context reference; unknown Git/context state preserves it.
Zero disables automatic cleanup through config/environment; Compose forwards the override.
Keep generated patch sidecars in the owning story namespace.

cases: Concurrent default open, explicit fresh and remote identity
Actual process restart with an unavailable remote
Principal/task isolation and stable task headers
Modified/untracked files, local commits, context links, active builds and missing Git metadata survive expiry
Read-only activity refreshes retention; zero disables expiry; corrupt context metadata preserves evidence
Activity during cleanup inspection and private patch paths
Failed preparation is cleaned and can be retried
Actual HTTP workspace operations across changed Open WebUI chat IDs under one task

tests.coverageGate: passed against the pre-change same-platform full-suite baseline
tests.ciWaitRegression: Deadline expiry after entering polling sleep is driven explicitly, avoiding dependence on a short wall-clock race.

limitations: No affected production workspace ID was provided; this is a local reproduction, not reconstruction of a particular deletion.
Different chats share a checkout only when the client selects the same original authenticated task/story.
Files already deleted before this change cannot be reconstructed by this fix.
Explicit workspace_drop remains destructive for the selected owned workspace.
Private task data is never automatically adopted into another principal/story.
